name: 42134 · Franklin, KY
findings: ZIP 42134 (Franklin) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 42134 (Franklin) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 42134 (Franklin) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 62% of all organizations here have no identified type.
